data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add a fixture preplanning dispatch over a 5-SC, 3-story epic that triggers intent-allocation-assistant, and assert the output includes at least one suggestion at each confidence tier (high, medium, low), the challenge round is exercised (planner identifies 1-2 low-confidence items), and the per-item acknowledge log records accept, edit, and reject at least once each.
**Why**: Validates the assistant's confidence-routing and acknowledge flow as a behavior, not just the agent contract.
**Scope**:
- IN: the 5-SC/3-story fixture and assertions on tier coverage, challenge round, and accept/edit/reject acknowledge log.
- OUT: the assistant agent and dispatch wiring (sc-8, consumed here).

## Done Definitions

- A fixture preplanning dispatch over a 5-SC, 3-story epic triggers intent-allocation-assistant and the captured output contains at least one suggestion at each of the high, medium, and low confidence tiers ← Satisfies: sc-11
- The fixture exercises the challenge round by having the planner identify 1-2 low-confidence assignments before proceeding ← Satisfies: sc-11
- The per-item acknowledge log produced by the fixture records the accept, edit, and reject paths at least once each ← Satisfies: sc-11
- The assistant-validation fixture runs in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables) and the test passes ← Satisfies: sc-11

## Considerations

- [Live-verified] SC11 asserts a runtime preplanning dispatch triggers the assistant, so the fixture runs in a configuration-isolated environment.
- [Coverage] The fixture must be constructed so the assistant genuinely produces all three confidence tiers; hand-curated SC/story scopes that force tier diversity are acceptable.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, I want an assistant-validation fixture that triggers the assistant on a 5-SC/3-story epic and exercises every confidence tier and acknowledge path, so that the routing UX is proven.
